newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-HAYNES HITS DOUBLE CENTURY AGAINST E.P..
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HAYNES HITS DOUBLE CENTURY AGAINST E.P..

text.p: opener Desmond Haynes hit a brilliant, unbeaten double century
for Western Province to provide the outstanding highlight at St
Haynes battered the Eastern Province attack to register his
maiden first-class century in South Africa on the second day of
the four-day Supersport Series cricket match.
The Barbadian batsman made 202 not out off 333 balls - with
21 fours and five sixes - to send Western Province soaring to a
daunting 401 for two declared in their first innings.
The visitors then captured four important wickets to have
the home team under pressure on 128 for four at the close -
still needing a further 124 to avoid the follow on.
Although Haynes' double century was the day's highlight,
there were also fine contributions from young Jacques Kallis,
with 94, and H.D. Ackerman, who hit 45 not out from 49
